user.title: Magmarium
user.description: Active volcanoes on a living globe. Choose the data sources and, optionally, volcanoes to watch (comma separated, e.g. Semeru, Merapi, Krakatau). Each watched volcano gets its own sensor.

data_description.sources: MAGMA Indonesia: official alert levels and VONA aviation notices (ash clouds) for Indonesia, updated every 10 minutes. Weekly report: worldwide activity from the Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program and USGS.
data_description.watched_volcanoes: Names as used by the sources, e.g. Semeru, Merapi, Anak Krakatau, Lewotobi, Etna.

error.no_sources: Select at least one data source.

source_down.title: {source} is not reachable
source_down.description: Magmarium could not load data from {source} for more than {hours} hours. The last known data is still shown. Nothing needs to be done if the source is only temporarily down; the issue disappears on its own once the source answers again.
